description: Return the angle, in radians from -#pi to #pi, from the positive x axis to the point (x, y), as ECMAScript Math.atan2(y, x) does; y comes first. A result that would be NaN, or a NaN argument, is an error. An integer is not accepted: write to_double(v).

errorsThrown.reason: the result would be NaN, or an operand is NaN
